purpose: City-specific parcel registry and safe public geometry route review
registryBasis: Shahjahanpur Nagar Nigam publishes a city map page and the official district portal links government land-record services. UP’s official BhuNaksha and Bhulekh portals provide cadastral-map/land-record services, tying the municipal and state workflow to Shahjahanpur, though not establishing parcel coverage for only the urban corporation.

officialSources.observation: Shahjahanpur Nagar Nigam publishes a city map page and the official district portal links government land-record services. UP’s official BhuNaksha and Bhulekh portals provide cadastral-map/land-record services, tying the municipal and state workflow to Shahjahanpur, though not establishing parcel coverage for only the urban corporation. The city map page is a static map; the official BhuNaksha viewer requires location and plot selection and can return land-record attributes. No district/tehsil/village/plot selection or parcel query was made because geometry-and-ID-only response fields were not verified.
